subject: Risk & Compliance
title: NotPetya: The Costliest Attack
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: NotPetya: The Costliest Attack.

hook.text: NotPetya looked like ransomware, but paying didn't decrypt your files. It was designed purely to destroy.

buildup.text: Russia launched NotPetya at Ukraine in 2017. It spread globally and caused $10 billion in damage.

discovery.text: Maersk, the world's largest shipping company, lost its entire IT infrastructure in minutes.

twist.text: A single Maersk office in Ghana had an old backup because of a power outage. It saved the company.

climax.text: NotPetya showed that cyber weapons can cause more economic damage than most conventional weapons.

punchline.text: $10 billion in damage. One lucky backup saved Maersk.

quiz.question: What made NotPetya different from typical ransomware?
options: It was designed to destroy, not collect ransom
It asked for a very small ransom
